evidence.intent_output: SEC-PROXY-001 AC-8: absolute-form GET http://evil.example/api/orders/x is 400 or forwarded only to the configured target; GET http://h/api/orders/%2e%2e/x is 400. Observed: the servlet adapter's originalUrl() is the origin-form path (scheme and authority stripped by the container, %2e%2e kept raw), so the PathChecker check yields 400 for %2e%2e and the evil.example request reaches the proxy as /api/orders/x; the proxy connects only to TargetUrl.host/port and writes Host from target.hostHeader() (or, under preserveHost, the received Host header, which stays 'localhost' — the absolute-form authority never reaches req.header('Host')).

findings.title: Servlet adapter absolute-form request target vs proxy path check (SEC-PROXY-001 AC-8)
findings.description: Residual from round 1: whether on the servlet adapter an absolute-form target could bypass PathChecker or steer the proxy. Execution shows originalUrl() holds only the raw origin-form path (+query) on Jetty, so the AC-8 outcome holds.
findings.suggested_fix: None required. Optionally a servlet-side AC-8 test belongs to a lane that may add :NaruServe-proxy to NaruServe-servlet's test classpath.

findings.drop_reason: traceability/documentation only; no behavioral defect proven
